direction: Co-evolve the dual hooks for the weakest regimes (n=100, spatial=uniform, depot=eccentric, demand=uniform, capacity=loose): (a) make `score_ruin_nodes` scale-invariant by normalizing removal savings by the per-instance mean edge length and by multiplying in a mild size-aware priority term so that at n=100 the ruin set spans multiple routes (route-coverage/depot-integration gating) rather than concentrating inside one dense route; (b) make `score_recreate_action` a capacity-slack- and detour-regret-weighted regrank: prefer the (customer, position) action with the strongest second-best-minus-best detour regret (Regret-2/3 blend) while penalizing actions that consume a large fraction of residual route capacity under loose capacity, and mildly favor filling near-empty routes early (eccentric-depot respect). Keep both hooks deterministic, tie-break by index, and bounded to a small softmax/bonus magnitude so the LNS baseline behavior is preserved as iter_frac -> 1.

operations.mechanism: Round-2 champion (session_r0002, mean 16.1100) still sits on a Pareto plateau where vbs-vs-sbs gap is only 0.114%, while the weakest-regime table shows uniformly negative rel gaps concentrated in n=100, uniform spatial, eccentric depot and loose capacity — i.e. the residual errors are structural (ruin-set geometry + slack-blind insertion) rather than budget-driven. KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 confirms the L3 skeleton fixes Recreate to deterministic Regret-2 and only exposes ruin scoring; the explicit 'unexplored dual-hook (ruin+recreate) co-tuning' limitation noted there is exactly the lever of the L3b dual-hook template. method-cvrp-cheapest-regret-insertion and method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret motivate replacing a slack-blind Regret-2 with a Regret-2/3 + capacity-slack blend, and method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings motivates scale-invariant savings normalization so the same hook transfers between n=50 and n=100 slices.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: Under a 500 ms budget, the dev_24 loss is dominated by (i) ruin sets that are geometrically localized in uniform/eccentric-depot instances and (ii) regret-2 recreate decisions that ignore residual capacity slack. Adding a scale-invariant, size-aware route-coverage gate to `score_ruin_nodes` and a capacity-slack-weighted Regret-2/3 blend to `score_recreate_action` will lower mean objective on the n=100 / uniform / eccentric / loose-capacity slices by >=0.15 units versus the round-2 champion (16.1100) without increasing solve_ms beyond the 500 ms budget envelope.
